about: What stands printed beside each form field of this form, and which tick boxes belong together: taken from the definition the form is built from (tools/forms/schadenmeldung-uvg.js). Applied by tools/correct.js. Where the model's question was wrong, did not hold or spoke to the wrong person, the question was written by hand (all questions of the form were read on 11 October 2026). The boxes of the kind of report and of the position are one choice each, of which one is ticked: set by hand, the form prints tick boxes. Day, month and year of the accident are one question; it is required, as its three boxes were before they became one unit.
